_comment: Canonical Go per-package mutation efficacy floors (percent). Single source of truth. Read directly by .github/scripts/gen_report_portal.py; api/Makefile and .github/workflows/nightly-mutation.yml mirror these values and are drift-guarded against this file by gen_report_portal_test.py (a mismatch fails CI). Technique shards aggregate into the single 'techniques' scope. Note: transport/http was removed (ARCH-2); it is a dev-only harness (see api/internal/transport/http/doc.go) and is no longer held to a production mutation floor.
